items.headline: On fourth-and-goal, Roach drops Mahomes and flips the AFC West race as Broncos beat Chiefs 28-24
items.description: — Malcolm Roach sacked Patrick Mahomes on fourth-and-goal on the final play Sunday, preserving Denver's come-from-behind 28-24 win over the Kansas City Chiefs that vaulted Broncos into first place in the AFC West.
